correctness.rationale: Independently reproduced from inputs/artifacts/kts-21-antipasch.txt: all 14 column-decoded systems validate as STS(21) (210 pairs exactly once) with 10 valid parallel classes each. Both Pasch counters give 0 on all 14; both mitre counters give [45,51,39,39,27,42,45,35,21,21,42,44,46,45] with minimum 21 on systems 8 and 9, exactly matching the claim. All 42 minimum witnesses verified as actual blocks. Counters cross-checked on Fano (7 Pasch) and cyclic STS(13). Result is machine-certified, honestly limited to the published 14-system dataset without re-enumeration of the 83M systems.

originality.rationale: Fused retrieval (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE, no partial failure) finds the nearest priors: Kokkala-Ostergard classification (83,003,869 anti-Pasch STS(21)s, 3 5-sparse, 14 KTS, dataset Zenodo 3899950) and Erskine-Griggs survey of symmetric STS(21)s. Neither states per-system mitre counts or the minimum 21 over the 14 resolvable anti-Pasch KTS(21)s; the dataset stores only systems plus Aut orders. No synonymous-notation, broader-census, or database source implies T_min=21. The exact minimum and the certified exclusion of a 5-sparse KTS(21) in this set are new.

value.rationale: TARGET route: exact minimum mitre count over the complete natural subset of 14 resolvable anti-Pasch KTS(21)s, deciding the pre-motivated question of a 5-sparse KTS(21) in this set. T_min=21 with full per-system counts and witnesses is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object, not known or mechanically implied, that a future researcher could need. It rules out resolvability coinciding with 5-sparsity here. Narrow but motivated exact datum permitted by STANDARD; not a textbook restatement, arbitrary slice, or tiny unmotivated gain.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal search returned 20 results: 6 duplicate the base set and 14 are new. The 4 overlapping nearest priors (classification paper, Zenodo dataset, NORCOM slides, Erskine-Griggs survey) were already compared literally and state only existence counts, never per-system mitre numbers. All 14 new results are general background (mitre/5-sparse definitions, anti-mitre existence spectra, handbook statements) or older KTS enumerations; the closest new item (rank 17, pre-classification KTS(21) paper) reports quadrilateral-free examples but no mitre counts. Nothing states, tabulates, or implies T_min=21, so originality PASS is preserved with no new decisive prior.

residual_risks: Completeness of the 14-system set is inherited from Kokkala-Ostergard (no independent re-enumeration of the 83M anti-Pasch STS(21)s); claim is explicitly relative to the published dataset.
